description: PROP-BILL-065 PAY.JP API encoding test (subscribe-flow.test.ts lines 831-843) does NOT actually verify encoding. It only checks that PayjpClient methods were called, not that form-urlencoded was used instead of JSON. The test comment acknowledges this: 'エンコード方式はクライアント実装の責務'. REQ-BILL-034 requires form-urlencoded encoding but this is untestable at the shell level since the PayjpClient interface abstracts away encoding. No PayjpClient implementation exists in the sprint to verify encoding.
